sources.title: README.md · ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Description Granite-4.2-8B is the mid-size reasoning model in the Granite 4.2 family. It delivers strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks by leveraging built-in <think>...</think> chain-of-thought. It supports flexible thinking modes — full thinking (default), non-thinking, and low-effort — allowing users to balance depth vs. latency on a per-query basis.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 brings native reasoning to enterprise agents
sources.snippet: In enterprise workflows, tasks can be ambiguous and involve many steps to complete. An AI model must be able to follow complex instructions, retrieve the correct information, choose the right tools, act in the right sequence, and verify the result. Reasoning helps Granite 4.2 navigate this process more reliably.
